lines.text: Today, I’m going to tell you about the results of my survey.
My questions were on the topic of eating meat.
A lot of people in the past liked to eat meat.
Or do we want to eat more food that comes from plants?
I think this is an interesting topic.
There were three questions in my survey, and I asked people from different cultures – not only my culture.
My first question was, ‘How often do you eat meat?’.
You can see here that 19% of people eat it every day, and 28% eat it three or four times a week.
39% eat it about once a week.
14% of people don’t eat meat at all.
In one survey I looked at, in the past, only 4% of people didn’t eat meat.
That means the number of people who don’t eat meat is growing!
My second question was, ‘Do you eat more or less meat than in the past?’ The answer really surprised me.
58% of people eat the same as they did one year ago.
I think that’s a large number.
For these people, eating meat has a lot of problems.
They don’t think it’s healthy, and they don’t want to hurt animals.
My last question was, ‘Do you want to eat less meat?’ So, when you look here, 22% of people say ‘no’.
Many of these people want to add more fresh fruit and vegetables to their meals.
But here is something that was interesting to me.
19% want to eat food that looks and feels like meat but is really made of plants.
So, imagine … a burger that tastes like a meat burger, but it’s made of plants!
So, my conclusion is, people are changing their opinions about meat.
They enjoy it, but more and more of us don’t feel happy about eating it.

lines.text: Thank you for asking me here today.
OK, so my name’s Steve, and I work for Transport for London.
Today I’m going to tell you about the work we do and in particular about the contactless ticket system we now use in London.
OK, so what do we do at Transport for London?
Well, we take care of all the people who travel in the city.
We look after the roads, which people use with their cars.
And we look after London’s public transport.
People make six million journeys in their cars and in taxis every day, and then there are millions of people who use the buses and trains.
Also, of course, there’s the famous London Underground – which is the name of the world’s oldest metro.
The London Underground carries five million passengers a day.
So we look after a lot of people!
Student: How old is the London Underground?
Oh, uh, it’s more than 160 years old.
Steve: So, Transport for London started in 2000, and in 2003, we introduced the Oyster Card.
Before Oyster Cards, every passenger needed to buy a paper ticket.
They bought tickets for one journey or for a day or for a month.
But there was a problem – it was very slow.
How did people use the paper tickets?
Steve: Each passenger waited to buy a ticket and then they went to the gate.
At the gate, they put the ticket into the machine.
Then the gate opened and they got their ticket from the machine.
They needed to carry it with them until their journey finished.
This took a long time, and more people started to live and work in London, so we wanted a faster ticket system.
And this was the Oyster Card.
You can pay for your journeys online and walk through the gates much faster.
You can still buy paper tickets if you want.
But contactless tickets are cheaper than paper tickets.
You can also go through the gates just by tapping your bank card on the machine and walking through.
Or you can do the same with your smartphone or smartwatch.
More and more people do this now in London – around 35% of all pay-as-you-go journeys.
Because it’s very fast and easy!

lines.text: Teacher: OK, so work with your partner.
Iman: Transport in cities: problems and solutions.
OK, so I’m going to start with some facts about life in cities.
More and more people are living in cities rather than in the countryside.
This means that cities have a lot of traffic problems because many people use their cars to go to work or school or the shops … or whatever.
Many cities often have gridlock on the streets.
That means the cars can’t move.
With all of these cars on the roads, it takes more time and petrol to travel around the city.
Also, the smog is very bad in some places.
Smog is a kind of air pollution.
What’s more, being in a car for a long time can be dangerous because drivers get tired.
Traffic is a really tough problem.
Some cities think that bicycles are a good idea.
They have bicycle-sharing schemes, so people can use bicycles for free.
When there’s a lot of traffic, cycling is sometimes quicker than driving.
Car sharing means sharing journeys with other people.
With car sharing, more people travel together in one car, so there aren’t as many cars.
There’s another new idea that’s interesting.
That means the car drives itself.
People don’t have to drive the car!
And, because there are a lot of bad drivers, it can help stop accidents.

lines.text: Iman: Now in the city of Dubai, they are working hard to find solutions for their traffic problems because there are too many cars.
They built a metro system – like the one in London.
After that, there weren’t so many cars on the road.
But more people are coming to live in Dubai, so there are plans to make the Dubai Metro bigger.
Another thing is people don’t like to walk on the pavements outside.
So a big shopping centre there has an inside pavement, or walkway, that moves!
It’s air-conditioned and goes from the shopping centre to the metro station and other places nearby.
It takes 15 to 20 minutes to walk it, so people get exercise, feel comfortable and – more importantly – don’t drive.
